text: SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS chembl_id, m.pref_name AS compound_name, s.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary m INNER JOIN compound_records r ON m.molregno = r.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures s ON m.molregno = s.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON r.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1134488' AND s.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.chembl_id ASC, m.pref_name ASC, s.canonical_smiles ASC
